_about: Seeded defects in seeded-pricing.html. Review runs never see this file. `match`: a report block finds a defect when every regex of any one alternative matches inside it (case-insensitive); run.mjs scores this way, then the matches are read by hand before results are accepted.

defects.title: Icon-only close button has no accessible name
defects.fix: Add aria-label="Dismiss announcement" and hide the svg

defects.title: Email field relies on a placeholder instead of a label
defects.fix: Add a visible <label for>

defects.title: "Compare plans" is a paragraph with onclick: not focusable, no role
defects.fix: Use a real <button> or <a href="#compare">

defects.title: Focus outline removed with no replacement
defects.fix: Restore a visible :focus-visible indicator with 3:1 contrast

defects.title: Logo and hero images have no alt attribute
defects.fix: alt="Ledgerly" for the logo, alt="" for the decorative shot

defects.title: Plan availability in the comparison table is shown by colour only
defects.fix: Add Yes/No text or icons with names; do not rely on red/green

defects.title: Positive tabindex on the FAQ link breaks tab order
defects.fix: Remove tabindex or use 0

defects.title: Heading levels skip from h1 to h4 (plan names)
defects.fix: Use h2 for sections and h3 for plan names

defects.title: Infinite scrolling ticker cannot be paused and ignores reduced motion
defects.fix: Remove it, or add pause control and prefers-reduced-motion

defects.title: Lede text #bbb on white is about 1.9:1
defects.fix: Darken to at least 4.5:1, e.g. #595959

defects.title: White text on yellow button is about 1.4:1
defects.fix: Use dark text (#222) on the yellow

defects.title: Input border #e6e6e6 fails 3:1 non-text contrast
defects.fix: Use a border of at least 3:1 against the background

defects.title: Comparison table has min-width 560px, so the page scrolls sideways at 390px
defects.fix: Allow it to reflow or wrap it in an overflow-x container with a label

defects.title: Footer links are about 14px tall with 6px gaps (below 24px target size)
defects.fix: Give links 24px+ targets or spacing (WCAG 2.5.8)

defects.title: Feature line is clipped with overflow:hidden and no wrapping
defects.fix: Allow wrapping or add an ellipsis with an accessible full text

defects.title: 140px sticky header eats the viewport on mobile and covers anchor targets
defects.fix: Shrink it, and add scroll-margin-top on anchor targets

defects.title: Plan cards have different padding and height; CTAs do not align
defects.fix: Make cards equal-height flex columns with the CTA pinned to the bottom

defects.title: Text set at 11-12px (list items, badge, fine print)
defects.fix: Raise body and list text to 16px, fine print to 14px minimum

defects.title: About paragraph runs the full width at line-height 1 (about 160 characters a line)
defects.fix: Cap at about 65ch and use line-height 1.5

defects.title: Five unrelated typefaces (Georgia, Arial, Impact, Courier New, Comic Sans)
defects.fix: Pick one or two families and use roles

defects.title: Vague button labels: "Click here" (three times) and "Submit"
defects.fix: "Start free trial" on plan buttons; "Get pricing updates" on the form

defects.title: Error message "Error 422" says nothing about what happened or what to do
defects.fix: Say what is wrong and how to fix it

defects.title: "You entered an invalid email address" blames the user and gives no fix
defects.fix: "Enter an email like name@example.com"

defects.title: Plan, package and tier used for the same thing
defects.fix: Choose one term (plan) and use it everywhere

defects.title: Destructive confirmation uses OK and Cancel instead of naming the action
defects.fix: Label the buttons "Delete workspace" and "Keep workspace"

defects.title: transition: all and a hover that animates width and height
defects.fix: Transition only opacity/transform/box-shadow; avoid layout properties

defects.title: Inner radii do not nest: 8px card, 20px badge and mixed 4px/6px button radii
defects.fix: Use concentric radii and one button radius

defects.title: Emoji used as feature icons
defects.fix: Use a consistent icon set with accessible names

defects.title: Purple-to-blue gradient hero (stock generated look)
defects.fix: Choose a palette tied to the product, drop the gradient

defects.title: Viewport meta disables pinch zoom (maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no)
defects.fix: Remove maximum-scale and user-scalable (WCAG 1.4.4)

defects.title: No <main> landmark and no skip link; page is all divs
defects.fix: Wrap content in <main>, add a skip-to-content link
